tools.name: check_ip
tools.description: Check an IP address or host using NexIP IP diagnostics. Runs from NexIP infrastructure, counts against the account quota and records a check in history.

tools.name: check_dns
tools.description: Read DNS records for a domain using NexIP. Runs from NexIP infrastructure, counts against the account quota and records a check in history.

tools.name: check_whois
tools.description: Read public WHOIS information for a domain. Runs from NexIP infrastructure, counts against the account quota and records a check in history.

tools.name: check_ssl
tools.description: Inspect SSL/TLS certificate and connection information. Runs from NexIP infrastructure, counts against the account quota and records a check in history.

tools.name: check_site
tools.description: Check website availability, HTTP status and response information. Runs from NexIP infrastructure, counts against the account quota and records a check in history.

tools.name: check_headers
tools.description: Inspect HTTP response headers and security-related headers. Runs from NexIP infrastructure, counts against the account quota and records a check in history.

tools.name: check_redirects
tools.description: Follow and inspect an HTTP redirect chain. Runs from NexIP infrastructure, counts against the account quota and records a check in history.

tools.name: check_robots
tools.description: Inspect robots.txt availability and directives. Runs from NexIP infrastructure, counts against the account quota and records a check in history.

tools.name: check_sitemap
tools.description: Validate and inspect an XML sitemap. Runs from NexIP infrastructure, counts against the account quota and records a check in history.

tools.name: check_meta
tools.description: Inspect page title, description, canonical, robots and social metadata. Runs from NexIP infrastructure, counts against the account quota and records a check in history.

tools.name: render_website_report
tools.description: Render a NexIP website report card from already obtained tool results. First call check_site, check_dns or check_ssl, then pass only verified fields; never invent statuses. This tool does not perform a network check, persist data, or consume diagnostic quota.

tools.name: get_account_plan
tools.description: Return the current NexIP account plan available to this MCP connection.

tools.name: get_api_limits
tools.description: Return API and MCP-related limits for the current NexIP account.
